lines.en: label beachwars13:
: Ladies and gentlemen!
: And anyone with an identity that either of the aforementioned titles do not properly describe!
scene beachcookoff1
: With two contests already underway and four others finished, the time has come for the hotly anticipated Sunday Dorm Wars Marathon!
: That’s right, people! And we’ve got a hell of a lineup for you beginning in just a few moments!
scene beachcookoff2
: Miss Imai, when I say the word “beach,” what is the first thing that comes to mind?
: Sharks!
: Try again!
: Scuba-diving!
: Try one more time, but think of something we already have a contest lined up for today!
: Food!
scene beachcookoff3
: Bingo! Which means our first contest of the day pits former best friends, Molly MacCormack and Rin Rokuhara, up against one another in an area no one could have ever expected!
: Will Rin be able to recover after being flashed by her bandmate? Has Molly figured out how to tone down her ADHD long enough to receive cooking advice from Tsuneyo?
: All these questions and more will be answered shortly!
scene beachcookoff4
: But before that, here’s a quick preview of everything else on the docket for today! Take it away, Imani!
: After what is sure to be the worst cookoff mankind has ever seen, we’ll be coming at you with a very special showdown between two more bandmates, Otoha Okakura and Sana Sakakibara!
: However! We have decided that, in the spirit of the no-longer-existing date war, to not televise either of these confessions as things like that are best done in private!
: Especially with a roster of girls so wet that you’d be able to tell we’re at the beach even without the giant ocean behind us!
scene beachcookoff5
: I don’t think you’re allowed to say that.
: I’m not! I just don’t get to hold the mic very often and got caught up in the moment.
scene beachcookoff1
: Ignoring what Imani just said and how correct she was in doing so, we’ll be moving right along after the confession battle to what might just be the most competitive contest of all!
: That’s right, folks! Ami Arakawa, Sensei’s dedicated and loving niece-slash-caretaker takes on Touka Tsukioka — Yasu’s loving friend-slash-caretaker!
: Two girls with two hearts of gold and one man with a heart made of muscle and blood and stuff! Which one of them would Sensei rather wake up to every morning?! And why is it Ami?!
: But that’s not all! We’ve got one more competition to wrap this trip up with, and it’s a dramatic faceoff between two childhood friends, Futaba Fukuyama and Nodoka Nagasawa!
scene beachcookoff6
: Any thoughts going into that last competition, Imani? Early polls have Nodoka winning by a landslide.
: I wouldn’t be so sure, Uta. Rumor has it that Nodoka might be planning on throwing the competition — citing a “lack of inspiration” as the purpose behind her deciding to pull out.
: I personally wouldn’t trust any rumor involving Nodoka and “pulling out.”
: I don’t think you’re allowed to say that.
scene beachcookoff1
: You’re probably right! Which means that both of us should take a few minutes to review the terms our network has laid out for us before our next televised event!
: But don’t touch that dial just yet! Because it seems like the cooking war is about to kick off!
: Now, let’s head on over to our contestants and see how they’re doing!
scene beachcookoff7
: Ohhhh man. Okay. Time to stop thinking about boobs and get my head back into the game.
: Why are there...so many different...spices?...Are we...are we...supposed to use them all?...
scene beachcookoff8
: Sana, as my carefully selected sous chef, this is something you should know. The answer is yes.
: I...don’t even understand...why you picked me in the first place, when...Futaba is...way better at cooking than I am...
: Futaba has a contest to prepare for.  Plus, she was very adamant about me learning to take care of myself for some reason.
: I...I think we might...have to learn that together, since...I’ve never even...used a knife before...
: Uh-oh! It looks like Rin has chosen an inexperienced partner as her sous chef for the cooking competition!
: What an intense handicap, Uta! Now there are three clueless cooks in the kitchen! And you know what they say about having too many cooks!
: They spoil the broth!
: No! They say that productivity slumps and that somebody is going to have to be sent home early so the business can make money!
scene beachcookoff9
: I...volunteer to...go home...
: Don’t listen to her. I need all the help I can get. Molly has Tsuneyo and that’s already an unfair advantage.
: Or is it?! Because it seems as if there is already a bit of turmoil in the opposing kitchen!
: Let’s head on over and check it out!
scene beachcookoff10
: What do you mean you did not refer to the numerous guides I provided you? I even took it upon myself to craft them in a manner you would be sure to understand.
: Kendo Princess, I appreciate you labeling your cookbook as a quest log, but you must understand that there are certain things I will simply never be able to grasp!
: Like the handle of this dagger as I do not have the required proficiency to wield it!
: Emerald Guardian, your lack of preparation is not only bewildering, but offensive to me as I have done all I can to help you.
: It’s fine! I’m fine! Rin has no idea what we’re doing either! And with you in my party, I can focus purely on channeling the elements to ensure our food is cooked!
: You expect me to win this contest for you?
scene beachcookoff11
: Isn’t that the sous chef’s job?! To do all of the hard work while the head chef sits back and takes credit for all of it?!
: I am hesitant to help you at all at this point as you have rejected both my kindness and skills in my efforts to instruct you.
: You can’t just aggro the trash and then quit the group, Kendo Princess! You’re gonna wipe the party!
: I am not yet fluent in “geek speak,” but to that I will say — the DPS is too low, the healer sucks, and the tank has been AFK for ten minutes. I am reporting all of you for gameplay sabotage.
scene black
: We could have just voted to kick the tank! You didn’t have to kill the whole group!
scene beachcookoff12
: Holy cannoli, Friendburger. Things are sure getting cray-cray over here in wet sand world.
: You can say that again.
: Holy cannoli, Friendburger. Things are sure getting cray-cray over here in wet sand world.
: You’re right about-
scene beachcookoff13
: Wait a minute, when did you two get here? And...why are you here?
: Today is the day of sun! The day of no creaming or sausage stuffing! The holes have been filled and the nuts are no more and all that is left is to enjoy being hot and wet!
: Was it necessary to bring Nao, though?
scene beachcookoff14
: Nao-chan has never set leg-hand on baby glass before. And so a thought bubble happened and I decided to show her a world unseen! And look how not-sad she is in response to this!
: I think she’s just excited about all of the food. And, not to ruin that for her or anything, but I doubt any of it will be edible.
: Anything is edible if your face hole can open wide enough and your insides are made of molten lava.
: I’m not sure if I understand that one, but you do you.
scene beachcookoff15
: My angel...she’s come back to me...
: Friendburger, help! A competitor in human trafficking has set its sights on Nao-chan and you must recover her before your share prices plummet!
: That’s just Chika. And if she does succeed in kidnapping Nao, I’m sure she’ll be easy to recover.
scene beachcookoff16
: Nao-chan! Do not gaze into her vision balls! She will consume the thoughts inside of you like the earth wolf consumes nesting termites!
: I knew you’d come back. I always believed.
scene sky
: Nao-chan, nooooooo!!!!!
The cooking competition officially begins with the ear-piercing screech of a whistle Uta removes from...somewhere. And the girls quickly begin pulling ingredients out of fully stocked refrigerators.
No further instructions are given, so I’m not sure if they’re just free to make whatever they want but, either way, I can’t imagine either side will succeed when all is said and done.
Kaori and Nao watch attentively, one significantly more attentively than the other...
But I decide to focus elsewhere as Nodoka and a certain niece of mine seem to be locked in a rather serious looking conversation.
I can’t make out what it might be about from over here.
I just know I don’t like the look of it.
scene beachcookoff17
: Okay, Sana! What are we making?!
: Isn’t that...something you should know...before you pick up that...giant knife?...
: Probably! But I’ve wanted to hold one of these meat thingies since I saw Rena use one in Higurashi!
: Just grab a bunch of stuff and let me chop it up! Meat, preferably! Everybody likes meat!
scene beachcookoff18
scene beachcookoff18
: Um...uhh...okay!
: I am the bone of my meat thingy...Flesh is my body and blood is my blood...
: I have created over a thousand microwavable dinners! Unknown to...non-microwavable dinners and...not known to...
scene beachcookoff19
: Fuck! I can’t remember how it goes!
: R...Rin! There are...so many different meats in here!
: Just grab all of them and we’ll figure it out later!
: Oh no! It looks like Team Rin hasn’t even figured out what they want to cook yet! But what about Team Molly?! How are they doing?!
scene beachcookoff20
: Somehow even worse!
: You are not even using the correct tool. How do you expect to create with an object made to destroy?
: Hell if I know, Kendo Princess! But I’m not about to go down without a fight, and a two-handed sword is far better to fight with than an iron dagger!
: The alternative is not an iron dagger. It is a stainless steel kitchen knife. And what you are wielding now is a blade so dull it would not even be able to cut through salmon.
scene beachcookoff21
: That’s it! Salmon! Retrieve me a salmon, great chef of the Sioux! For I will slay it and bring justice to my house!
: And how do you intend to prepare this salmon, Emerald Guardian?
scene beachcookoff22
: All that matters is that it is prepared...for death.
: You are going to lose this competition if that is the best you can come up with.
: To die by the blade is to earn a spot in Valhalla. And if that is my fate, so be it.
scene black
scene beachcookoff23
: Well, Imani- we’re twenty minutes into our competition now and neither side seems to have a clear goal in mind to come out on top. What are your thoughts on everything we’ve seen so far?
: That our class should be paying more attention in home economics!
: I couldn’t agree more! Even a dummy like me knows how to grill a fish.
: But does a dummy like you know how to grill a blobfish?
: Probably not! But why do you ask, Imani? What could that mean?
: I’ll tell you exactly what it means, Uta!
scene beachcookoff24
: It means it’s time for the mandatory cooking competition “twist!”
: A twist?! Twenty minutes into the competition?! But what does that mean for all of the careful preparation and planning that has gone into both dishes thus far?!
: Absolutely nothing! Because Team Rin’s grill is packed with overseasoned meat and Team Molly’s grill is packed with...nothing! There is nothing on Team Molly’s grill.
: What, Sana? I’m in the zone.
: Somebody just...handed me something...and...and I think...you’re supposed to cook it?...
: Well, hurry up and bring it over then! I’ll clear up some room for it!
scene beachcookoff25
: Rin, I think it’s still alive. I can feel it breathing and it’s all slippery.
: Just put it on the fucking grill, Sana! I don’t have time for this!
scene beachcookoff26
: Yes, chef!
: Ew! What the fuck is that thing?! It’s got a face!
: I don’t know but I don’t like it!
: Me neither! Get it off the grill!
: Don’t make me touch it again, chef!
: Damn it, Sana! You’ll do what I tell you and you’ll like it!
: No I won’t, chef!
scene beachcookoff27
: Get your head in the game, soldier! Do you want to sleep at Sensei’s house or not?!
: I have no idea, chef!
: Well, I kind of do! And if you ever want to borrow another FPS, you better grab that weird face fish and throw it back into the ocean! Now!
: Yes, chef!
scene beachcookoff28
: Kendo Princess, I believe we may just lose this competition.
: I believe that is essentially inevitable at this point due to your indecision and desire to simply wave around a katana instead of cooking.
: In regard to the secret ingredient you were provided, what would be your suggested method of cooking it?
: I am not sure as I have never seen such a creature before. But I have decided to close its eyes as it seems intelligent and I do not believe it should be aware that death is on the horizon.
: Is it anything like a salmon?
: Is that truly something you should be asking after refusing to cook the last salmon I brought you?
: I made eye contact with it. I couldn’t follow through, Kendo Princess.
scene beachcookoff29
: It was already filleted. There were no eyes to make contact with.
: Damn these advanced druidic powers and my ability to communicate with animals long after they have perished!
scene beachcookoff30
: Guardian, vanquish this fish immediately. As your master, I command you.
: Will you use a command seal?
: I do not know what that is. I just know that this ingredient must be used and that we are running out of time. Do not look into its eyes. Nor the ones in its heart.
: I’m not even sure this is a fish. It looks more like a slime.
scene beachcookoff31
: Unfortunately for it, slimes are the lowest level creature in many JRPGs...and one that I am all too familiar with slaying.
: This is the perfect chance to begin my journey...and begin it shall.
: I am the bone of my sword...Steel is my body and-
: I already used that monologue! Get your own!
scene beachcookoff32
: Damn it, Nithhala! You don’t even have a sword!
: Why do you have a sword?! Where did you even get it?!
: It was in the fridge!
: Why?!
: I don’t know! It just was!
: Guardian, time is running-
scene sky
: Die, slime!
Molly brings her sword down and...
And completely misses.
She swings it again and...
Well, she makes contact this time. But the blade is so dull that it sort of just bounces off of the weird creature and comes back at her.

But, after ten minutes of repeatedly swinging, the fish is reduced to pieces, just...none of them look particularly edible and I’m pretty sure that the “special ingredient” is the “only” ingredient in her dish.
scene beachcookoff33
: Well, Sensei! Now that both teams are finished cooking, and I use the word “cooking” very lightly here, are you excited to dig in and judge the dishes?!
: No.
: In fact, I've decided I'm just not going to do that.
: But...But someone needs to judge them! You can’t grade food on just the presentation alone!
: You do it then.
: I had a big breakfast. I’m not hungry.
: Same here. Looks like everyone loses.
: But...but somebody has to-
scene beachcookoff34
: Nao-chan?! Are you sure?! Neither of the foods that were fooded are foods that you’ve unfooded yourself before! It could be dangerous!
scene beachcookoff35
: I understand.
scene beachcookoff36
: Small girl with large chestular flesh-pouches!
: Yes?!
: Nao-chan will unfood the foods!
: Are you sure about this, Kaori? It’s very possible that she’ll die. In fact, I’d probably wager at this point that it’s likely she will die.
: Nao-chan has made the decision herself, Friend. And she deserves freedom as much as the rest of us do.
: That is great news! But please be advised that we should not be held responsible for any injuries or fatalities that take place as a result of the consumption of the “food” made here today.
scene sky
All of us who have been forced to pay attention to the cooking contest watch carefully as Nao approaches both dishes.

And while neither of them look particularly alluring, Rin’s does look at least edible. The one made by Molly is essentially just a hastily chopped-up looking version of the “fish” she was asked to cook.
In spite of that, though...Nao lifts it up and takes a small bite out of what I am pretty confident used to be its head.

But, after chewing it for an uncomfortable amount of time, she spits it right back out onto the plate before marching over to Rin’s dish and likely attempting to forget whatever it was she just put in her mouth.
Nao does seem to like Rin’s food more, as she’s actually able to swallow it — the only thing is that I’m not sure if she’ll be disqualified for omitting the mystery ingredient.
scene beachcookoff37
: Follow your heart, Nao. Search deep within yourself and think about what makes cooking important to you.
: And even if your answer goes against what my partner managed to create, know that I will not-
scene beachcookoff38
: Yeah, that’s fair.
: Heck yeah! Thank you, strange girl who showed up out of nowhere! I knew I could count on you! Just not really because you’re a strange girl who showed up out of nowhere!
: No fair! Rin didn’t even use the secret ingredient! I became a murderer for the sake of my dish! The weight of death weighs heavily upon my conscience!
: A true chef would not care at all about such a thing.
: On the topic of the mystery ingredient, the correct move was actually not using it!
scene beachcookoff39
: What?!
: You heard that right, Molly! Cooking shows always have some kind of twist ingredient chefs need to incorporate in order to win, but our twist was having an ingredient you’re not supposed to use!
: A real chef would know that the blobfish is basically inedible! Rin having Sana throw hers away was the only smart move either team made all day!
: This is an injustice! I demand a reroll!
: Accept the loss, Emerald Guardian. I too have failed you in not properly identifying an inedible ingredient.
: This can not be how my undefeated streak comes to an end! I will not stand for it!
scene beachcookoff40
: How’s it feel to lose to someone with zero wins, Molly? Gonna report me for cheating?
: I don’t have to, Nithhala. Everyone here knows you cheated by not following the rules of the contest! Plus my KDR was higher than yours and we all know that’s what really matters.
: Sorry, can you say that again? I’m having trouble hearing you from all the way up here in the winners’ bracket.
$ beachwarfloor1points += 1
scene black
: You will rue the day you crossed Molly MacCormack! This is not the end! It is not- ack!
: You will be coming with me now, Guardian. I will no longer allow you to ignore my instructions and will turn you into the greatest chef to have ever lived.
: But I’m tired of working! I want to play games!
A team of who I can only imagine are workers hired by Touka show up to break down all of the equipment and-
: Umm...Sensei?...
And a soft tug on my sleeve pulls me away from one competition I don’t care about toward one that I do.
$ beachwars13 = True
jump beachwars14
